title: Collaborations
subtitle: Interested in collaborating with mommi or Andersson & Hensfelt? We love creating new opportunities together with others.
heading: Let’s create something together
text1: We are always open to exciting collaborations and projects that feel genuine and create value for our users.
text2: This could include events, content creation, influencer collaborations, company partnerships, or other creative ideas connected to mommi and our community.
text3: Do you have an idea or want to know more about how we work with collaborations? Feel free to reach out and let’s talk more.
